figurative_meaning_en: The destruction of a husband and wife's married life
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের ঘর ভাঙ্গা হয়ে গেছে, এখন আলাদা থাকছে।
অনেক কলহের পর তাঁদের ঘর ভাঙ্গা হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: Their home is broken; they are living separately now.
After much quarreling, their marriage fell apart.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali emphasis on family unity.
